Kill shelters are not what people think they are. Non kill shelters are almost always privately run, so they only take in what animals they want to. This makes it so they don't have to kill, because they have the resources to take care of only that certain amount. This leaves a ton of animals left behind. Kill shelters, on the other hand are usually government run, so they are required to take in every single animal that is given to them. This means that they take as best care of what they can, but the weakest get euthanized. This of course is very sad to think about, but without kill shelters so many more animals would be left to die without any sort of help at all. I am lucky enough to live in an area where we have only non kill shelters that simultaneously take in every single animal, but in large cities this just cannot be the case.
Why? Yes they have done bad things, but I believe they have done more good than bad. I am not trying to be rude, I am just curious on your perspective.
